_about: Which PRs get which review layers (ways-of-work-lean-pass D5/D7). reviewScope 'every-pr' = the fresh pr-reviewer subagent + one external general pass on every non-trivial PR. securityPaths decides the lean external security lens (cross-review.mjs --lens security) in every scope: the multi-tenant read paths, auth/tokens, the public and connector surfaces, migrations, middleware and CI config.
